In [2]:

            

        

        

            
 

            

                
Forecasting Latent In-Room Physical Occupancy from Hotel Booking Telemetry for Dynamic Energy Load Prediction


* Advanced ML notebook  |  Two-Stage Predictive Workflow
* Stage 1 : Occ_physical = f(Occ_sales, Month, Season, CDD)
* Stage 2 : E_hvac       = f(CDD, Occ_physical_hat, Delta_Occ)

            

        

        

            
 

            

                
0.0  Abstract


Hotel property-management systems (PMS) report sales occupancy between 68 % and
98 %, yet IoT in-room sensing reveals physical presence of only 51 %–78 %. This
"occupancy divergence" corrupts HVAC baseline models used for Measurement &
Verification (M&V). This notebook implements and stress-tests a two-stage
predictive workflow on 19 monthly billing cycles from a commercial hotel
undergoing an IoT automation retrofit by an energy-analytics start-up
(hereafter "the Vendor").

* Stage 1 forecasts latent physical presence with Support Vector Regression
  (RBF kernel), Gaussian Process Regression and tree ensembles.
* Stage 2 injects the forecast physical-presence signal into the HVAC load
  pipeline and benchmarks it against the traditional sales-occupancy baseline.

All vendor brand names, product names and automation-mode labels have been
anonymised.

                              GradientBoostingRegressor, VotingRegressor,

def load_raw() -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Load the raw vendor export, falling back to the embedded copy."""
    if os.path.exists(CSV_PATH):

        print(f"Loaded '{CSV_PATH}' from disk.")
    else:
        df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(RAW_CSV))
        print("Embedded dataset used (sensordata.csv not found on disk).")
    return df

Cleaning, typing and derived features

            

        

        

            
In [5]:

            

                
# =============================================================================
# CELL 3 — Cleaning, typing, feature derivation
# =============================================================================

# ---- 3.1  numeric coercion --------------------------------------------------
NUM_COLS = ["energy_total_kwh", "occ_sales", "energy_nonhvac_kwh",
            "energy_savings_claimed_kwh", "energy_hvac_kwh", "occ_physical",
            "cdd_18c", "automode_standard", "automode_deep", "automode_disabled"]

for c in NUM_COLS:
    df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

# setback setpoint is encoded as a string like "24c" / "25c"
df["setback_setpoint_c"] = pd.to_numeric(
    df["setback_setpoint_c"].astype(str).str.extract(r"(\d+\.?\d*)")[0],
    errors="coerce")

# ---- 3.2  datetime handling -------------------------------------------------
df["month_id"]  = df["month_id"].astype(int).astype(str)
df["date"]      = pd.to_datetime(df["month_id"], format="%Y%m")
df["month_num"] = df["date"].dt.month
df["year"]      = df["date"].dt.year

_split          = df["billing_period"].str.split("-")
df["bill_start"] = pd.to_datetime(_split.str[0], format="%d/%m/%Y")
df["bill_end"]   = pd.to_datetime(_split.str[1], format="%d/%m/%Y")
df["bill_days"]  = (df["bill_end"] - df["bill_start"]).dt.days + 1

# ---- 3.3  automation-mode shares -------------------------------------------
for c in ["automode_standard", "automode_deep", "automode_disabled"]:
    df[c] = df[c].fillna(0.0)

df["automode_sum"] = df[["automode_standard", "automode_deep",
                         "automode_disabled"]].sum(axis=1)

# ---- 3.4  cyclical month encoding (captures seasonality smoothly) -----------
df["month_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["month_num"] / 12)
df["month_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["month_num"] / 12)

# ---- 3.5  season label (tropical cooling regime) ----------------------------
def season_of(m):
    if m in (11, 12, 1, 2):  return "Cool-Dry"
    if m in (3, 4, 5):       return "Hot-Dry"
    if m in (6, 7, 8, 9):    return "Monsoon"
    return "Post-Monsoon"

df["season"] = df["month_num"].map(season_of)

# ---- 3.6  occupancy divergence metrics --------------------------------------
df["occ_gap"]       = df["occ_sales"] - df["occ_physical"]
df["occ_gap_ratio"] = df["occ_gap"] / df["occ_sales"]

# ---- 3.7  energy diagnostics ------------------------------------------------
df["hvac_share"]     = df["energy_hvac_kwh"] / df["energy_total_kwh"]
df["nonhvac_share"]  = df["energy_nonhvac_kwh"] / df["energy_total_kwh"]
df["energy_per_cdd"] = df["energy_total_kwh"] / df["cdd_18c"].replace(0, np.nan)
df["hvac_per_cdd"]   = df["energy_hvac_kwh"] / df["cdd_18c"].replace(0, np.nan)

# ---- 3.8  retrofit phase flag ----------------------------------------------
df["retrofit"] = np.where(df["iot_platform_installed"].eq("Yes"),
                          "Post-retrofit", "Pre-retrofit")

# ---- 3.9  data-quality checks ----------------------------------------------
df["energy_sum_check"] = df["energy_nonhvac_kwh"] + df["energy_hvac_kwh"]
df["energy_residual"]  = df["energy_total_kwh"] - df["energy_sum_check"]

print("=== Data quality: sub-meter reconciliation (non-HVAC + HVAC vs total) ===")
print(df.loc[df["energy_sum_check"].notna(),
             ["month_id", "energy_total_kwh", "energy_sum_check", "energy_residual"]]
        .to_string(index=False))

print("\n=== Coverage ===")
print(f"Total billing cycles          : {len(df)}")
print(f"Cycles with physical occupancy: {df['occ_physical'].notna().sum()}")
print(f"Cycles with sub-metered HVAC  : {df['energy_hvac_kwh'].notna().sum()}")
print(f"Cycles missing physical occ.  : {df.loc[df['occ_physical'].isna(),'month_id'].tolist()}")

df.to_csv("hotel_energy_clean.csv", index=False)
df.head()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(14, 9), sharex=True,
                         gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": [2.2, 1]})

ax = axes[0]
d = df.copy()
ax.bar(d["date"], d["energy_nonhvac_kwh"].fillna(0), width=22,
       color=C["nonhvac"], label="Non-HVAC load", edgecolor="white", linewidth=.5)
ax.bar(d["date"], d["energy_hvac_kwh"].fillna(0), width=22,
       bottom=d["energy_nonhvac_kwh"].fillna(0),
       color=C["hvac"], label="HVAC load (sub-metered)", edgecolor="white", linewidth=.5)
ax.plot(d["date"], d["energy_total_kwh"], color=C["total"], marker="o",
        ms=6, lw=2.2, label="Total metered energy", zorder=5)

ax.axvspan(pd.Timestamp("2025-03-01"), d["date"].max(),
           color="#27AE60", alpha=0.06, zorder=0)
ax.text(pd.Timestamp("2025-03-15"), d["energy_total_kwh"].max()*0.96,
        "  Post-retrofit (sub-metering active)", fontsize=9,
        color="#1E8449", va="top")

ax.set_ylabel("Energy (kWh / month)")
ax.set_title("Figure 1a — Monthly energy composition: total, HVAC and non-HVAC")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(kfmt))
ax.legend(loc="upper right", ncol=2, frameon=True)
sns.despine(ax=ax)

Stage 1 model zoo and leave-one-out benchmark

# =============================================================================
# CELL 11 — Stage-1 leave-one-out benchmark across feature sets and learners
# =============================================================================
def make_model_zoo():
    """Return a dict of (name -> sklearn estimator) for regression."""
    return {
        "Baseline (mean)":
            DummyRegressor(strategy="mean"),

        "Ridge (L2)":
            Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()), ("m", Ridge(alpha=1.0))]),

        "Lasso (L1)":
            Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()), ("m", Lasso(alpha=0.005, max_iter=20000))]),

        "Elastic Net":
            Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                      ("m", ElasticNet(alpha=0.01, l1_ratio=0.5, max_iter=20000))]),

        "Bayesian Ridge":
            Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()), ("m", BayesianRidge())]),

        "Huber (robust)":
            Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()), ("m", HuberRegressor(epsilon=1.35))]),

        "kNN (k=3, dist)":
            Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                      ("m", KNeighborsRegressor(n_neighbors=3, weights="distance"))]),

        "SVR (RBF)":
            Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                      ("m", SVR(kernel="rbf", C=10.0, gamma="scale", epsilon=0.02))]),

        "SVR (linear)":
            Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                      ("m", SVR(kernel="linear", C=1.0, epsilon=0.02))]),

        "Gaussian Process (RBF)":
            Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                      ("m", GaussianProcessRegressor(
                          kernel=(ConstantKernel(1.0, (1e-2, 1e2))
                                  * RBF(length_scale=1.0, length_scale_bounds=(1e-2, 1e2))
                                  + WhiteKernel(noise_level=0.01,
                                                noise_level_bounds=(1e-5, 1e-1))),
                          normalize_y=True, n_restarts_optimizer=12,
                          random_state=RANDOM_STATE))]),

        "Random Forest":
            Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                      ("m", RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=600, max_depth=3,
                                                  min_samples_leaf=2,
                                                  random_state=RANDOM_STATE, n_jobs=-1))]),

        "Extra Trees":
            Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                      ("m", ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=600, max_depth=3,
                                                min_samples_leaf=2,
                                                random_state=RANDOM_STATE, n_jobs=-1))]),

        "Gradient Boosting":
            Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                      ("m", GradientBoostingRegressor(n_estimators=250,
                                                      learning_rate=0.04,
                                                      max_depth=2,
                                                      subsample=0.9,
                                                      random_state=RANDOM_STATE))]),
    }


def loo_scores(model, X, y):
    """Leave-One-Out cross-validated R2 / MAE / RMSE."""
    yhat = cross_val_predict(model, X, y, cv=LeaveOneOut())
    return (r2_score(y, yhat),
            mean_absolute_error(y, yhat),
            np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y, yhat)),
            yhat)


records, preds_store = [], {}

for fs_name, feats in FEATURE_SETS_S1.items():
    X = S1[feats].values
    for mname, model in make_model_zoo().items():
        r2, mae, rmse, yhat = loo_scores(model, X, y1)
        records.append(dict(feature_set=fs_name, model=mname, n_feat=len(feats),
                            R2=r2, MAE=mae, RMSE=rmse))
        preds_store[(fs_name, mname)] = yhat

bench1 = (pd.DataFrame(records)
            .sort_values(["R2", "MAE"], ascending=[False, True])
            .reset_index(drop=True))

print("=== Stage-1 LOOCV benchmark — TOP 15 configurations ===")
display(bench1.head(15).round(4))

Stage 1 : hyper-parameter tuning of the champion learner (nested CV)

            

        

        

            
In [18]:

            

                
# =============================================================================
# CELL 13 — Stage-1 : nested-CV tuning of the SVR champion
# =============================================================================
BEST_FS_NAME = "F4 · Sales + month + CDD"
BEST_FEATS   = FEATURE_SETS_S1[BEST_FS_NAME]
X1 = S1[BEST_FEATS].values

svr_pipe = Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                     ("m", SVR(kernel="rbf"))])

param_grid = {
    "m__C"       : [0.5, 1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500],
    "m__gamma"   : ["scale", 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0],
    "m__epsilon" : [0.002, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.08],
}

inner_cv = KFold(n_splits=6, shuffle=True, random_state=RANDOM_STATE)

gs_svr = GridSearchCV(svr_pipe, param_grid, cv=inner_cv,
                      scoring="neg_mean_absolute_error", n_jobs=-1, refit=True)
gs_svr.fit(X1, y1)

print("Best SVR hyper-parameters :", gs_svr.best_params_)
print(f"Best inner-CV MAE         : {-gs_svr.best_score_:.4f}")

# --- honest nested-CV estimate (outer LOOCV, inner 6-fold grid search) ------
yhat_nested = cross_val_predict(clone(gs_svr), X1, y1, cv=LeaveOneOut(), n_jobs=-1)

nested_r2   = r2_score(y1, yhat_nested)
nested_mae  = mean_absolute_error(y1, yhat_nested)
nested_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y1, yhat_nested))

print("\n=== Nested-CV (outer LOOCV) performance of tuned SVR ===")
print(f"  R2   = {nested_r2:.4f}")
print(f"  MAE  = {nested_mae:.4f}  ({nested_mae*100:.2f} occupancy points)")
print(f"  RMSE = {nested_rmse:.4f}")

Stage 1 : final model, uncertainty quantification and imputation

            

        

        

            
In [19]:

            

                
# =============================================================================
# CELL 14 — Stage-1 final fit, GPR uncertainty, imputation of the blind period
# =============================================================================
# --- 14.1 tuned SVR refit on all observed cycles ----------------------------
svr_final = clone(gs_svr.best_estimator_).fit(X1, y1)

# --- 14.2 Gaussian Process for calibrated uncertainty ------------------------
gpr_pipe = Pipeline([
    ("sc", StandardScaler()),
    ("m", GaussianProcessRegressor(
        kernel=(ConstantKernel(1.0, (1e-2, 1e2))
                * Matern(length_scale=1.0, length_scale_bounds=(1e-2, 1e2), nu=1.5)
                + WhiteKernel(noise_level=0.01, noise_level_bounds=(1e-5, 1e-1))),
        normalize_y=True, n_restarts_optimizer=15, random_state=RANDOM_STATE))
])
gpr_pipe.fit(X1, y1)
print("Learned GP kernel:", gpr_pipe.named_steps["m"].kernel_)

# --- 14.3 predict across the WHOLE timeline ---------------------------------
X_all = df[BEST_FEATS].values
sc_all = gpr_pipe.named_steps["sc"].transform(X_all)
mu_all, sd_all = gpr_pipe.named_steps["m"].predict(sc_all, return_std=True)

df["occ_physical_hat_svr"] = svr_final.predict(X_all)
df["occ_physical_hat_gpr"] = mu_all
df["occ_physical_sd_gpr"]  = sd_all

# --- 14.4 blend: use sensor truth where available, model elsewhere ----------
df["occ_physical_final"] = np.where(df["occ_physical"].notna(),
                                    df["occ_physical"],
                                    df["occ_physical_hat_gpr"])

df["occ_gap_final"] = df["occ_sales"] - df["occ_physical_final"]

# --- 14.5 performance on the observed window --------------------------------
obs = df["occ_physical"].notna()
print("\n=== In-sample fit on observed cycles ===")
print(f"  SVR  R2 = {r2_score(df.loc[obs,'occ_physical'], df.loc[obs,'occ_physical_hat_svr']):.4f}"
      f" | MAE = {mean_absolute_error(df.loc[obs,'occ_physical'], df.loc[obs,'occ_physical_hat_svr']):.4f}")
print(f"  GPR  R2 = {r2_score(df.loc[obs,'occ_physical'], df.loc[obs,'occ_physical_hat_gpr']):.4f}"
      f" | MAE = {mean_absolute_error(df.loc[obs,'occ_physical'], df.loc[obs,'occ_physical_hat_gpr']):.4f}")

print("\n=== Imputed latent physical occupancy for the pre-sensing period ===")
cols = ["month_id", "occ_sales", "occ_physical", "occ_physical_hat_gpr",
        "occ_physical_sd_gpr", "occ_gap_final"]
display(df.loc[~obs, cols].round(4))

for xi, yi, mi in zip(y1, yhat_loo, S1["month_id"]):

# =============================================================================
# CELL 16 — Stage-2 design matrices (Pipeline A / B / B')
# =============================================================================
S2 = df.dropna(subset=["energy_hvac_kwh"]).copy().reset_index(drop=True)

# --- out-of-sample Stage-1 forecasts (LOOCV) to feed Pipeline B' ------------
s1_loo = cross_val_predict(clone(gs_svr.best_estimator_),
                           S1[BEST_FEATS].values, y1,
                           cv=LeaveOneOut(), n_jobs=-1)
S1_out = S1[["month_id"]].copy()
S1_out["occ_physical_oos"] = s1_loo
S1_out["occ_gap_oos"]      = S1_out.merge(
    S1[["month_id", "occ_sales"]], on="month_id")["occ_sales"] - S1_out["occ_physical_oos"]

S2 = S2.merge(S1_out, on="month_id", how="left")

# --- interaction term : weather x true presence -----------------------------
S2["cdd_x_occ"] = S2["cdd_18c"] * S2["occ_physical"]
S2["cdd_x_gap"] = S2["cdd_18c"] * S2["occ_gap"]

PIPELINES = {
    "A · Traditional baseline\n(CDD + sales occupancy)":
        ["cdd_18c", "occ_sales"],

    "B · Latent-presence architecture\n(CDD + sensed O_phys + ΔOcc)":
        ["cdd_18c", "occ_physical", "occ_gap"],

    "B+ · Latent + weather interaction":
        ["cdd_18c", "occ_physical", "occ_gap", "cdd_x_occ", "cdd_x_gap"],

    "B' · End-to-end (Stage-1 out-of-sample O_phys)":
        ["cdd_18c", "occ_physical_oos", "occ_gap_oos"],
}

y2 = S2["energy_hvac_kwh"].values

print(f"Stage-2 observations : n = {len(S2)}")
print(f"HVAC energy range    : {y2.min():,.0f} – {y2.max():,.0f} kWh")
print(f"Mean HVAC energy     : {y2.mean():,.0f} kWh")

# =============================================================================
# CELL 17 — Stage-2 LOOCV benchmark : pipeline x learner
# =============================================================================
def make_model_zoo_s2():
    """Stage-2 learner pool. Regularisation is deliberately strong because
    n = 10 observations only."""
    return {
        "Ridge (L2)"      : Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()), ("m", Ridge(alpha=10.0))]),
        "Lasso (L1)"      : Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                                      ("m", Lasso(alpha=50.0, max_iter=50000))]),
        "SVR (RBF)"       : Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                                      ("m", SVR(kernel="rbf", C=200.0,
                                                gamma="scale", epsilon=8000.0))]),
        "Gaussian Process" : Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                                       ("m", GaussianProcessRegressor(
                                           kernel=(ConstantKernel(1e5, (1e2, 1e8))
                                                   * RBF(1.0, (1e-2, 1e2))
                                                   + WhiteKernel(1e5, (1e-2, 1e8))),
                                           normalize_y=True, n_restarts_optimizer=15,
                                           random_state=RANDOM_STATE))]),
        "Random Forest"   : Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                                      ("m", RandomForestRegressor(
                                          n_estimators=800, max_depth=2,
                                          min_samples_leaf=2, random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
                                          n_jobs=-1))]),
        "Gradient Boosting": Pipeline([("sc", StandardScaler()),
                                       ("m", GradientBoostingRegressor(
                                           n_estimators=180, learning_rate=0.05,
                                           max_depth=1, subsample=0.9,
                                           random_state=RANDOM_STATE))]),
    }

rows2, preds2 = [], {}
for pname, feats in PIPELINES.items():
    X = S2[feats].values
    for mname, model in make_model_zoo_s2().items():
        yhat = cross_val_predict(model, X, y2, cv=LeaveOneOut(), n_jobs=-1)
        rows2.append(dict(
            pipeline=pname.replace("\n", " "),
            model=mname,
            n_features=len(feats),
            R2=r2_score(y2, yhat),
            MAE=mean_absolute_error(y2, yhat),
            RMSE=np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y2, yhat)),
            MAPE_pct=np.mean(np.abs((y2 - yhat) / y2)) * 100,
        ))
        preds2[(pname, mname)] = yhat

bench2 = (pd.DataFrame(rows2)
            .sort_values(["R2", "MAE"], ascending=[False, True])
            .reset_index(drop=True))

print("=== Stage-2 LOOCV benchmark — all configurations ===")
display(bench2.round(4))

lims = [0, max(y2.max(), yhat_c.max(), yhat_b.max()) * 1.10]
ax.plot(lims, lims, "k--", lw=1.6)
ax.set_xlim(lims); ax.set_ylim(lims)
ax.set_xlabel("Observed HVAC (kWh)"); ax.set_ylabel("LOOCV forecast (kWh)")
ax.set_title("Figure 9b — Parity: sales-occupancy vs physical-presence features")
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(kfmt))
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(kfmt))
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
sns.despine(ax=ax)

# ---- 9c : residuals ---------------------------------------------------------
ax = axes[1, 0]
res_b, res_c = y2 - yhat_b, y2 - yhat_c
ax.axhline(0, color="k", lw=1)
ax.bar(S2["date"] - pd.Timedelta(days=6), res_b, width=11,
       color="#95A5A6", label=f"Pipeline A  (σ={res_b.std():,.0f})")
ax.bar(S2["date"] + pd.Timedelta(days=6), res_c, width=11,
       color=C["phys"], label=f"Pipeline B  (σ={res_c.std():,.0f})")
ax.set_ylabel("Residual (kWh)")
ax.set_title("Figure 9c — Residual structure")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(kfmt))
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5)
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.MonthLocator(interval=1))
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%b-%y"))
plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha="right")
sns.despine(ax=ax)

# ---- 9d : permutation importance -------------------------------------------
ax = axes[1, 1]
pi = permutation_importance(champ, Xc, y2, n_repeats=60,
                            random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
                            scoring="neg_mean_absolute_error")
imp = pd.DataFrame({"feature": champ_feats,
                    "importance": pi.importances_mean,
                    "std": pi.importances_std}).sort_values("importance")
ax.barh(imp["feature"], imp["importance"], xerr=imp["std"],
        color=C["accent"], edgecolor="k", linewidth=.6, capsize=4)
ax.set_xlabel("Δ MAE when permuted (kWh)")
ax.set_title("Figure 9d — Permutation importance, Pipeline B champion")
sns.despine(ax=ax)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(f"{OUTDIR}/fig09_stage2_diagnostics.png", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()

Setback-strategy scenario engine

            

        

        

            
In [26]:

            

                
# =============================================================================
# CELL 21 — Scenario engine : occupancy-gap-aware setback scheduling
# =============================================================================
# NOTE — This is an ILLUSTRATIVE scenario model, not a validated savings claim.
# It propagates the forecast latent vacancy through a user-controlled
# setback-efficiency parameter and sweeps that parameter to expose sensitivity.

def setback_scenario(frame, setback_efficiency, vacancy_metric="occ_gap_final",
                     hvac_col="energy_hvac_kwh"):
    """
    Estimate avoidable HVAC energy when automated setback is applied
    proportionally to forecast latent vacancy.

    Parameters
    ----------
    setback_efficiency : float in [0,1]
        Fraction of the unoccupied-room HVAC load that a setback schedule
        can realistically curtail (swept, not assumed).
    """
    f = frame.copy()
    f["avoidable_kwh"] = (f[hvac_col].fillna(0)
                          * f[vacancy_metric].clip(0, 1)
                          * setback_efficiency)
    return f

eff_grid = np.arange(0.05, 0.51, 0.05)
scen = pd.DataFrame({
    "setback_efficiency": eff_grid,
    "avoidable_kwh": [setback_scenario(S2, e)["avoidable_kwh"].sum() for e in eff_grid],
})
scen["avoidable_pct_of_hvac"] = (scen["avoidable_kwh"]
                                 / S2["energy_hvac_kwh"].sum() * 100)
scen["vendor_claimed_kwh"] = S2["energy_savings_claimed_kwh"].sum()

print("=== Illustrative setback scenario — sensitivity to setback efficiency ===")
display(scen.round(2))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 6))

ax = axes[0]
ax.plot(scen["setback_efficiency"]*100, scen["avoidable_kwh"]/1000,
        "o-", color=C["green"], lw=2.5, ms=8)
ax.axhline(S2["energy_savings_claimed_kwh"].sum()/1000, color=C["phys"],
           ls="--", lw=2, label=f"Vendor-claimed savings "
                                f"({S2['energy_savings_claimed_kwh'].sum()/1000:,.0f} MWh)")
ax.fill_between(scen["setback_efficiency"]*100, 0, scen["avoidable_kwh"]/1000,
                color=C["green"], alpha=.15)
ax.set_xlabel("Assumed setback curtailment efficiency (%)")
ax.set_ylabel("Avoidable HVAC energy over the window (MWh)")
ax.set_title("Figure 11a — Occupancy-gap-aware setback potential")
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
sns.despine(ax=ax)

ax = axes[1]
per_month = setback_scenario(S2, 0.25)
ax.bar(per_month["date"], per_month["energy_hvac_kwh"], width=20,
       color="#D5DBDB", label="Observed HVAC")
ax.bar(per_month["date"], per_month["avoidable_kwh"], width=20,
       color=C["green"], label="Modelled avoidable (25 % setback efficiency)")
ax.plot(per_month["date"], per_month["occ_gap_final"]*per_month["energy_hvac_kwh"].max()/0.4,
        color=C["accent"], marker="D", lw=2, ms=6,
        label=r"$\Delta$Occ (scaled, right axis)")
ax.set_ylabel("HVAC energy (kWh)")
ax.set_title("Figure 11b — Month-by-month avoidable load")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(kfmt))
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5, loc="upper right")
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.MonthLocator(interval=1))
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%b-%y"))
plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha="right")
sns.despine(ax=ax)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(f"{OUTDIR}/fig11_setback_scenario.png", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()

Limitations and reporting notes

            

        

        

            
 

            

                
8. Limitations, threats to validity, and reporting guidance


8.1 Small-sample regime.  
Stage 1 operates on 14 monthly observations and Stage 2 on only 10. All reported
R² values are leave-one-out cross-validated, and the SVR champion is additionally
validated by nested cross-validation (inner 6-fold grid search, outer LOOCV) so
that the headline number is not inflated by hyper-parameter selection. Even so,
with n ≈ 10 a ±0.05 shift in R² is within noise. Report confidence intervals or
a bootstrap distribution rather than a single point estimate.

8.2 Monthly aggregation masks sub-monthly dynamics.  
The occupancy gap is fundamentally a daily and hourly phenomenon. Monthly
averages compress the signal: a 0.20 monthly gap corresponds to roughly six
un-occupied room-days per room per month, but the true distribution is bimodal
(fully occupied conference weeks vs. near-empty weekends). Any deployment should
re-run the Stage-1 model on daily telemetry.

8.3 Structural break at the retrofit boundary.  
The automation-mode mix, the setback set-point (25 °C → 24 °C) and the
sub-metering granularity all change across the sample. The model therefore
conflates behavioural vacancy with control-policy changes. A difference-in-
differences or interrupted-time-series design is required before attributing
energy changes to the latent-occupancy feature rather than to the retrofit itself.

8.4 Scenario outputs are illustrative, not validated savings.  
Cell 21 sweeps a curtailment-efficiency parameter rather than estimating it from
data. Present the scenario as a sensitivity band, never as a verified saving.

8.5 Anonymisation.  
All Vendor brand names, product names (setback-mode labels) and platform
identifiers have been replaced with neutral descriptors. The property, the
portfolio it belongs to and the client identity are not disclosed.

8.6 Recommended manuscript edits.
1. Replace the abstract's numerical claims with the values printed in Cell 23.
2. Add a "Data and Validation Protocol" subsection stating n, the LOOCV/nested-CV
   scheme, and the small-sample caveat.
3. Rename SF installed → IoT platform installed, and the automation modes to
   generic Standard / Deep / Disabled setback labels.
4. Move the sensor-vendor name out of the title, abstract and acknowledgements.
